# Jeff Hallstead

> Jeff Hallstead (Momentive Ventures) helps brand and marketing leaders operate like media companies: original programming, distribution, and the measurement to prove it works, so a brand builds an audience it owns instead of renting one through ads. He has worked inside the media business (Warner Bros, Disney, Paramount, Comcast/NBCU, Amazon Studios) and built the content function on the brand side.

He works as a fractional Chief Content Officer and executive producer for brand teams carrying a content mandate without the senior hire. Specialties include branded entertainment, branded series and documentary, podcasts, animation, and branded microdramas (serialized short-form narrative for mobile platforms).

## Services

- [Home](https://jeffhallstead.com/): Overview of the offer: connect what people watch with what they buy, and build an audience the brand owns.
- [Services / Content Studio](https://jeffhallstead.com/content-studio): Fractional content leadership for brand and marketing teams: original programming, distribution, and measurement.
- [Productions](https://jeffhallstead.com/productions): Executive producer work across documentary, branded series, podcasts, animation, and short-form narrative, from concept and financing to premiere.
- [Branded Microdramas](https://jeffhallstead.com/microdramas): Original serialized short-form narrative developed for brand partners, with a former Guiding Light story editor.
- [Contact](https://jeffhallstead.com/contact): Book a 45-minute strategy conversation about whether branded entertainment is the right move.

## Case studies

- [Pour Les Femmes](https://jeffhallstead.com/case-study-plf): Digital transformation that grew DTC revenue 4x in the first year and reached customers in over 50 countries.
- [SustainAble Exchange](https://jeffhallstead.com/case-study-sae): An integrated brand, marketplace, and institutional platform connecting ESG-aligned organizations.
- [Founder's Ceiling Quiz](https://jeffhallstead.com/case-study-founders-ceiling-quiz): An interactive quiz built and deployed in under an hour with an AI-native workflow.
- [SDG Alignment Advisor](https://jeffhallstead.com/case-study-sdg-advisor): An AI agent that maps a mission statement to the UN's 17 SDGs and 169 targets.
